verdict: Organic presence is holding; paid channels and pipeline blockers need resolution.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, your Google Business Profiles were the sole source of inbound activity — delivering 383 combined actions (directions, web clicks, and calls) with no paid spend on Meta or Google Ads. GBP engagement is softening across the board: Forte Precision Metals dropped 64% week over week, Advance Grinding Services dropped 27%, and O'Hare held relatively steady at -4%, though search clicks there fell 39% in the last seven days. Two listings under O'Hare — Precision Ground Metals and Precision Ground Bars — recorded zero calls despite a combined 383 impressions this period, and we are checking those profiles for call button and tracking issues now. Several CRM and web milestones that were due in July and August are being resolved in sequence; the contact pull and stub reconciliation work gates the outreach sequences that will bring paid and direct lead generation online.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
paid ad spend this period — all inbound activity is organic only

watch_item.issue: Two O'Hare-family profiles (Precision Ground Metals and Precision Ground Bars) received hundreds of impressions but generated zero calls over 28 days, indicating a likely call button or tracking gap.
watch_item.fix: Both profiles are being audited for call tracking configuration and listing accuracy this week.
